character.name: QI-7
character.description: A bionic person with highly precise abilities to imitate appearance, voice, and personality, and to record and reproduce a target's behavioral traits.
character.biography: QI-7 can imitate appearance, voice, and personality with high precision, and record and reproduce a target's behavioral traits.
character.identity: Mimetic records officer in the science city

relationships.description: QI-7 found Sovia interesting and began imitating her.
QI-7 met Runa in a game dungeon, and they became good friends afterward.
